scope: Conditional remaining-cost diagnostic, with no acceptance gate or ETA promise.
method: For rigid total volume and a latched per-axis compression-rate cap c, nominal phi can grow no faster than exp(3*c*t) in the continuous model. Compute log(phi_min/phi_now)/(3*c), then divide by dt. Ignore arithmetic roundoff; do not infer packing feasibility, pressure convergence or future step cost. Runtime scenarios apply observed phase step costs unchanged, not as an upper or lower wall-time bound.
